weapons.name: Aura Combat Skill
weapons.details:
Those gifted in Aura are often very good in combat, being able to sense their opponents and infuse their attacks with this mystical power.
Traits: Characters who have at least 3 Skill Points in Aura may make other attacks they are able to normally do using Aura instead of Brawl or Weapons. Characters using the Aura skill gain access to the following basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Aura Infused Blow
maneuvers.description: The User strikes at the flow, while infusing their attacks with aura power.
maneuvers.effect: Aura Maneuver. Never Miss.

maneuvers.name: Pre-empt
maneuvers.description: The User focusses on the battle, reading the Foe’s Movements and intentions.
maneuvers.effect: The User may make an additional Evasion or Clash per Round (as long as they have the Actions to do so).

maneuvers.name: Aura Ora-Ora-Ora
maneuvers.description: The User lays a furious flurry of blows on the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Aura Maneuver. Successive Actions.

maneuvers.name: Stunning Blow
maneuvers.description: The User strikes at the Foe’s nerves or pressure points attempting to slow their Movements.
maneuvers.effect: Aura Maneuver. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.

weapons.name: Axes
weapons.details:
A Weapon that can either be used to hack at or be thrown at the enemy. Not as much finesse as a sword, but still just as deadly.
Traits: Characters wielding an axe gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Gouging Hacks
maneuvers.description: The User hacks at the enemy savagely.
maneuvers.effect: Successive Actions. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Whirling Death
maneuvers.description: The User throws an axe at the Foe, the sound of it whirling through the air being often the last thing the enemy hears.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Furious Gouge
maneuvers.description: The User hacks at the Foe furiously.
maneuvers.effect: High Critical. Lethal.

weapons.name: Blowpipes
weapons.details:
Blowpipes lean into precise, silent attacks and their payloads are often coated with various compounds, producing additional effects.
Traits: A character using a blowpipe may declare at the beginning of the Round they will only make 3 Actions. They may add +1 Dice to the Damage Pool of their attacks made with this Weapon that Round. Characters wielding a blowpipe gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Deadeye Shot
maneuvers.description: The User fires a precise shot at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Precise Aim
maneuvers.description: The User steadies themself, slows their heart rate and takes a shot.
maneuvers.effect: Accuracy +1. Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Late Reaction 4. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Coated Dart
maneuvers.description: The User launches a dart covered in a strange compound at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.

weapons.name: Bows and Crossbows
weapons.details:
The human race has created a lot of ways of killing each other, over time we’ve decided its often best to do so from a distance where the person you’re attempting to kill can’t do the same to you. Arrows and Bolts may have to be purchased or crafted at the Storyteller’s discretion.
Traits: Characters wielding a bow or crossbow gain access to two basic types of ranged Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Deadeye Shot
maneuvers.description: The User fires a precise shot at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Charged Shot
maneuvers.description: The User takes their time and draws back the string to the maximum.
maneuvers.effect: Charge Maneuver. Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Burning Shot
maneuvers.description: The User ignites their projectile, then fires a flaming shot at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn (1) the Target.

weapons.name: Channelling Combat Skill
weapons.details:
Those gifted with mystical abilities are able to bend the battlefield and their opponents to their will.
Traits: Characters making a non-Weapon attack with the Channel Skill may choose to make the Target All Foes, or add +2 Bonus Dice to the Damage Pool of their Maneuver, but in doing so they immediately suffer 1 Level of Exhaustion. (For more see P37). Characters using the Channel Skill gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Arcane Blast
maneuvers.description: The User unleashes their power towards their enemy.

maneuvers.name: Stun-Lock
maneuvers.description: The User attempts to painfully stun the Foe, stopping them in their tracks.
maneuvers.effect: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.

maneuvers.name: Psionic Barrage
maneuvers.description: The User unleashes a barrage of psionic power, but is left drained afterwards.
maneuvers.effect: The User immediately takes 2 Levels of Exhaustion.

maneuvers.name: Mindscape
maneuvers.description: The User envisions a strange realm in their minds eye and makes it tangible.
maneuvers.effect: The User sets Psychic Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

weapons.name: Clubs, Flails, Hammers and Maces
weapons.details:
Large blunt weapons that deal crushing powerful crushing blows.
Traits: Characters wielding a bow or crossbow gain access to two basic types of Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Crushing Strike
maneuvers.description: The User brings down their Weapon on the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Bludgeon
maneuvers.description: The User strikes at the Foe, enough to Damage but not to kill.
maneuvers.effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.

maneuvers.name: Skull Sunder
maneuvers.description: The User strikes at the Foe’s head with full force attempting to annihilate them.
maneuvers.effect: Must Recharge. Lethal.

weapons.name: Daggers, Knives and Short Blades
weapons.details:
A simple short blade, they comes in many varieties and shapes, such as a Stiletto knife, Wakizashi or even a Gyarados’ fang.
Traits: Characters wielding a Dagger, Knife or Short Blade gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Double Strike
maneuvers.description: The User lashes out striking the Foe multiple times.
maneuvers.effect: Double Action. High Critical. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Skewering Throw
maneuvers.description: The User flicks a blade at the Target.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Hidden Blade
maneuvers.description: The User attempts to feint the Foe, producing a blade from seemingly thin air.
maneuvers.effect: Reaction 6. Late Reaction 1. High Critical. Lethal. This Maneuver may be used as a Reaction or as a Late Reaction at convenience of the User. If this Maneuver is not used to react against a Physical or Special attack it will fail.

maneuvers.name: Whisper Slash
maneuvers.description: The silently lunges at the Foe, slashing with a razor sharp edge.
maneuvers.effect: Never Miss. High Critical. Lethal.

weapons.name: Energy Weapons
weapons.details:
These high-tech weapons use concentrated electrical energy, plasma, or focused light to deal Damage. Other weapons may have the Energy Weapon keyword, though only Firearms may have the Laser or Plasma sub-type and only other weapon types may have the Power sub-type.  

**Laser sub-type Traits:** Maneuvers made with this Weapon do Special Damage, and gain Roll 1 Chance Dice to ignore Defenses.  
  
**Plasma sub-type Traits:** Overheat. Maneuvers made with this Weapon do Special Fire-Type Damage, gain +1 Damage Dice and Roll 2 Chance Dice to Burn (1).
**Overheat:** After firing this Weapon, roll a Luck Check, on a 25 or lower, the Weapon overheats and the wielder must spend their next Action waiting for it to cool down, before it can be used again.  

**Power sub-type Traits:** Maneuvers made with this Weapon do Electric-Type Damage and gain High Critical, Roll 1 Chance Dice to Paralyze.

weapons.name: Firearms
weapons.details:
Firearms are all deadly and deal devastating Damage, but diversify into various styles.
Traits: Characters wielding a firearm gain access to two basic Maneuvers. A firearm must have (only) one of the following sub-types.
Single Shot sub-type Traits: Maneuvers made using this Weapon deal +1 Damage Dice.
Burst sub-type Traits: Maneuvers using this Weapon may be made as Double Actions.
Automatic sub-type Traits: Maneuvers made using this Weapon have -1 Accuracy and -1 Damage Dice but may be made as Successive Actions.

maneuvers.name: Deadeye Shot
maneuvers.description: The User fires a precise shot at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. High Critical.

maneuvers.name: Crippling Shot
maneuvers.description: The User aims specifically for points on the Foe’s anatomy that will cripple them.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.

maneuvers.name: Fast Draw
maneuvers.description: The User draws, aims and shoots in a split-second.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Reaction 3.

maneuvers.name: Piercing Shot
maneuvers.description: The User fires a Round specifically designed to go through heavy armor.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Reduce the Target’s Defense by 1.

maneuvers.name: Precise Aim
maneuvers.description: The User steadies themself, slows their heart rate and takes a shot.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Never Miss. Late Reaction 4.

weapons.name: Great Weapons
weapons.details:
Great weapons such as a Two-handed Sword, War Hammer or Great Axe. They’re very heavy and somewhat cumbersome but can deal a lot of Damage.
Traits: Characters wielding a Great Weapon require 3 Strength and their Dexterity is decreased by 1. and may not use a shield or dual wield while using this Weapon. Characters wielding a great Weapon gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Crushing Blow
maneuvers.description: The User brings their full force and the weight of their Weapon down on the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Arcing Cleave
maneuvers.description: The User swings their Weapon Round attempting to hit multiple enemies.
maneuvers.effect: After rolling Damage, you may roll 1 Dice of Damage against two other Targets. Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Wild Spin
maneuvers.description: The User swings their Weapon in a spinning motion, attempting to hit multiple enemies.
maneuvers.effect: Rampage. Lethal. Until the User’s next Action they have +1 Defense and Special Defense.

weapons.name: Halberds, Spears and Polearms
weapons.details:
Spears and various types of Polearms have a long reach compared to other melee weapons.
Traits: Characters wielding a Weapon of this type may make Non-Ranged Physical attacks without triggering effects caused by Non-Ranged Physical attacks. Characters wielding them gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Piercing Thrust
maneuvers.description: The User jabs at the Foe from a distance.
maneuvers.effect: Lethal. This Maneuver does not trigger effects that activate when the Target is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical attack.

maneuvers.name: Sentinels Reach
maneuvers.description: The User keeps the Foe in combat, not letting them escape.
maneuvers.effect: Blocks. This Maneuver does not trigger effects that activate when the Target is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical attack.

maneuvers.name: Impaling Throw
maneuvers.description: The User launches their Weapon at the Foe, hoping to impale them.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. High Critical.

weapons.name: Improvised Weapons
weapons.details:
A broom, chair, a metal pipe, bottle, or even a humble rock etc.
Traits: Characters wielding an improvised Weapon gain access to two basic Maneuvers. (Certain Improvised Weapons may make Stronger or Weaker attacks or have additional effects at the Storyteller’s discretion)

maneuvers.name: Swinging Crash
maneuvers.description: The User swings an improvised Weapon hoping to strike the Foe.

maneuvers.name: Chuck It
maneuvers.description: The User hurls an improvised Weapon at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. ???.

maneuvers.name: Kobudo
maneuvers.description: The User has learned to masterfully use their environment and anything in it during a fight.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. ???.

weapons.name: Kusarigama
weapons.details:
Curved hand-sickle(s) attached to a long chain with a counterweight. The chain controls distance, snaring, tripping, and creating openings so the sickle can finish the job.
Traits: Characters wielding a kusarigama gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Binding Reap
maneuvers.description: The User swings one blade towards their Foe, binding and sharply pulling them towards them.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to deal Ongoing Damage 1. Duration: until the User Targets a different Active Combatant.

maneuvers.name: Unbalance
maneuvers.description: The User swings their Weapon wildly, attempting to unbalance the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. The Target’s next Non-Reaction Move or Maneuver is made at Late Reaction 6.

maneuvers.name: Swinging Slashes
maneuvers.description: The User makes multiple vicious slashes at the Foe while swinging the counterweight.
maneuvers.effect: Successive Actions.

weapons.name: Kunai, Throwing Darts and Throwing Stars
weapons.details:
Ancient types of ranged weapons, proceeding the bow and arrow. But still deadly effective in the right hands.
Traits: The usual rule of using an Action to swap between weapons does not apply to weapons of this type. Characters wielding kunai, throwing darts or stars gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Skewering Throw
maneuvers.description: The User flicks a blade at the Target.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal.
maneuvers.source: Kunai, Throwing Darts and Throwing Stars

maneuvers.name: Piercing Wind
maneuvers.description: The whips a collection of thrown blades at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Successive Actions. Lethal.
maneuvers.source: Kunai, Throwing Darts and Throwing Stars

maneuvers.name: Coated Dart
maneuvers.description: The User launches a dart covered in a strange compound at the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
maneuvers.source: Kunai, Throwing Darts and Throwing Stars

maneuvers.name: Deflect
maneuvers.description: The User flicks a blade, deflecting a projectile or thrown item.
maneuvers.effect: Accuracy -2. Ranged. Reaction 3. Destroy a thrown Poke Ball or Block all Damage from a Single Target Physical Projectile Move or Projectile Maneuver completely. (At the Storyteller’s discretion).
maneuvers.source: Kunai, Throwing Darts and Throwing Stars

weapons.name: Nunchaku and Staves
weapons.details:
Blunt but powerful weapons often wielded defensively and favoured by martial artists.
Traits: Characters wielding Nunchaku or Staves gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Serpentine Strike
maneuvers.description: The User spins their Weapon in a fast circular motion, catching the Foe off guard.
maneuvers.effect: Reaction 1.

maneuvers.name: Spinning Deflect
maneuvers.description: The User spins their Weapon in an attempt to deflect and disarm the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Shield Maneuver. Reaction 3. Reduce 3 Damage from a Damaging attack. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Disarm the Target.

maneuvers.name: Whirpool Riposte
maneuvers.description: The User counters with a strong riposte after receiving Damage.
maneuvers.effect: This Maneuver can only deal Damage if the Target has dealt Special Damage to the User this Round. Roll the same Damage Pool as your Target plus 2 Extra Dice.

maneuvers.name: Whirlwind Riposte
maneuvers.description: The User sacrifices defense for an empowered returned strike.
maneuvers.effect: This Maneuver can only deal Damage if the Target has dealt Physical Damage to the User this Round. Roll the same Damage Pool as your Target plus 2 Extra Dice.

weapons.name: Swords
weapons.details:
They come in many shapes and sizes, from Scimitars to Fencing Rapiers, some say the pen is mightier but obviously those people haven’t been a real fight.
Traits: Characters wielding a Sword gain access to two basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Sweeping Slash
maneuvers.description: The User slashes at the Foe with a sharp edged blade.
maneuvers.effect: Lethal.

maneuvers.name: Parry
maneuvers.description: The User attempts to deflect a Foe’s attack.
maneuvers.effect: Shield Maneuver. Reaction 1. Reduce 2 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging attack. If the Target used a Non-Ranged Physical attack roll 1 Dice of Damage against them.

maneuvers.name: Disarming Flourish
maneuvers.description: The User attempts to disarm the Foe with a series of quick thrusts and turns.
maneuvers.effect: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Disarm the Target. In the case of Pokémon remove their Held Item.

maneuvers.name: Piercing Lunge
maneuvers.description: The User lunges for the Foe’s weak point.
maneuvers.effect: High Critical. Lethal.

weapons.name: Shields
weapons.details:
Shields offer decent protection and in a push can be used a Weapon.
Traits: Characters using two handed or great weapons may not use a shield.
Characters using a shield have +1 Defense and Special Defense but get -1 to their Accuracy rolls with other weapons they are also wielding.
Characters wielding a Shield gain access to the following basic Maneuvers.

maneuvers.name: Shield Strike
maneuvers.description: The User bashes the Foe with their shield.

maneuvers.name: Shield of Valor
maneuvers.description: The User brings their shield up to protect themself or an Ally.
maneuvers.effect: Shield Maneuver. Reaction 5. Reduce 3 Damage the User or the Target would receive from a Damaging attack.

maneuvers.name: Protective Strike
maneuvers.description: The User brings their shield up quickly before striking at their Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Shield Maneuver. Reaction 5. Set Damage. May only be used when an attack successfully hits the User or a Target. Lessen the Damage from that attack by 3. Deal 1 Damage to the attacker.

weapons.name: Unarmed Combat Skill
weapons.details:
Why bother with complex weapons or fancy gadgets when your fists and feet or a solid headbutt can get the job done?
Traits: Characters who use the Brawl skill (Unarmed) gain access to two basic Maneuvers:

maneuvers.name: Unarmed Strike
maneuvers.description: The User strikes at the Foe with a basic attack.

maneuvers.name: Haymaker
maneuvers.description: The User winds up a powerful blow that may leave the Foe stunned.
maneuvers.effect: Late Reaction 5. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.

maneuvers.name: Disarming Strike
maneuvers.description: You Strike at the Foe’s wrist, attempting to disarm them.
maneuvers.effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Disarm the Target. In the case of Pokémon they lose their Held Item.

maneuvers.name: Flying Fist Flurry
maneuvers.description: The User lands a succession of strikes on the Foe.
maneuvers.effect: Successive Actions.

maneuvers.name: Hullbury Kiss
maneuvers.description: The User headbutts the Foe at full force.
maneuvers.effect: Recoil.

maneuvers.name: Knockout Punch
maneuvers.description: The User attempts to OHKO the Foe with a single hit.
maneuvers.effect: Accuracy -5. Deal Damage equal to the Target’s remaining HP +1.

maneuvers.name: Leaping Elbow Drop
maneuvers.description: The User leaps at the Foe, crashing down with their full weight behind their elbow on them.
maneuvers.effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. After dealing Damage, reduce the User's Dexterity by 1.

maneuvers.name: Pre-Emptive Blow
maneuvers.description: The User senses the Foe’s intent and tries to outspeed them.
maneuvers.effect: Late Reaction 6. This Maneuver can only be used after the Target rolls a Damaging Move or Maneuver.

weapons.name: Blood Thirsty Axes
weapons.details:
This pair of battle worn, rune engraved axes are known to send their wielder into a berserk rage. Perhaps it is just the way they feel in your hand, or perhaps the spirit of a long dead warrior resides in them.
Additional Traits: The User can declare they won't make any Evasions at the start of the Round. If they do, all attacks made with these weapons gain +1 Damage Dice.

maneuvers.name: Berserker's Fury
maneuvers.effect: Increase the User’s Strength and Defense by 1.

weapons.name: Blazing Armor
weapons.details:
This mystical armor seems to resemble that which Armarouge and Ceruledge use.
Additional Traits: While wearing this armor, the wearer’s Maneuvers do Fire-Type Damage, the wearer also gains Resistance to Fire-Type Damage.

maneuvers.name: Blazing Blitz
maneuvers.effect: High Critical. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn (1) the Target. If successful, spend 3 Will Points to activate.

weapons.name: Codex of the Unown
weapons.details:
This ancient tome is filled with mysterious symbols. It resonates with a strong mystical energy.
Traits: The wielder’s unarmed Special attacks gain +1 Damage Dice.

maneuvers.name: Glyphs of the Unspoken
maneuvers.effect: Sound Maneuver. High Critical. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.

weapons.name: Echo Gauntlets
weapons.details:
These mysterious gauntlets seem to amplify the aura abilities of those using them.
Traits: The User’s Aura Skill is Increased by 1 while wielding these weapons. Unarmed attacks the wearer makes gain +1 Damage Dice.

maneuvers.name: Spiritual Resonance
maneuvers.effect: The Target may not Evade Maneuvers performed by the User. Add the successes of this Maneuver to any rolls made to track the Target outside of combat.

weapons.name: EX-Suit
weapons.details:
This strange high-tech, armored bodysuit gives its wearer supernatural strength and speed.
Traits: Characters wearing this armor have +2 Defense and Special Defense.

maneuvers.name: Augmented Abilities
maneuvers.effect: Reaction 3. Increase the User’s Strength and Dexterity by 2. If successful spend 2 Will Points to activate.

weapons.name: Gunblade
weapons.details:
This elegant and masterfully crafted Weapon can be used to both cut and shoot.
Traits: Single Shot. The wielder gains access to their normal Sword Maneuvers and Crippling Shot from the Firearm list.

maneuvers.name: Trigger-Finger Finisher
maneuvers.effect: Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Reaction 6. Never Miss. High Critical. (This Maneuver may only be Used immediately after you have successfully rolled Damage against the Target with a Non-Ranged Maneuver using this Weapon).

weapons.name: Needle Pistol
weapons.details:
This long barrelled, masterwork laser pistol is elegantly wrought, with silver filligree decorating it.
Additional Traits: Energy Weapon (Laser). Burst.

maneuvers.name: Needlepoint
maneuvers.effect: Double Action. Roll 2 Chance Dice to ignore Defenses.

weapons.name: NoH Face Mask
weapons.details:
The mask's surface shimmers with memetic camouflage. Strange tech that obscures the wearer’s face and often fully “bricks” surveillance and ocular devices that catch sight of them.
Traits: Characters wearing this mask gain +1 Point in the Stealth Skill. Moves, Maneuvers and Commands that target the wearer lose Never Miss.

maneuvers.name: Digital Camo
maneuvers.effect: Shield Maneuver. Reaction 3. Reduce by 3 the Damage the User would receive from an attack. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Attacker.

weapons.name: Obliterator
weapons.details:
This large cannon-like firearm wreaks utter devastation when it is fired.
Additional Traits: Single Shot. Other attacks made with this Weapon have -1 Accuracy and gain +1 Damage Dice. If a Character with less then 3 Strength is wielding this Weapon, all attacks made with it gain Recoil.

maneuvers.name: Obliteration
maneuvers.effect: Accuracy -2. Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Lethal. Must Recharge.

weapons.name: Overquil Spine Blowpipe
weapons.details:
This ornately carved blowpipe coats its payload in Tetrodotoxin, causing its victims to suffer a horrible death.
Additional Traits: All attacks made with this Weapon gain Roll 2 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Foe.

maneuvers.name: Paralyzing Needle
maneuvers.effect: High Critical. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.

weapons.name: Personal Shield Emitter
weapons.details:
The AI in this emitter can (usually) detect when the wearer would be severely damaged and prevents it, by projecting a temporary but very powerful forcefield around them.
Traits: Once used the device must recharge for 3 Rounds.

maneuvers.name: Forcefield
maneuvers.effect: Shield Maneuver. Reaction 6. Negate all Damage and effects the User would receive.

weapons.name: Psi-Enhancer
weapons.details:
This curious high end neural augmentation was developed by a shady organisation, who where attempting to enhance the ability of those with psychic powers. They where successful, but the test subject destroyed their facility and escaped by manipulating their tech against them.
Traits: The implantee gains +1 to their Special Attribute.

maneuvers.name: Technoshred
maneuvers.effect: If the User is in the Facility, Foundry or Urbanized Field-Types or in a Technology filled location: This Maneuver does Steel-Type Damage and gains +2 Damage Dice.

weapons.name: Repeating Crossbow
weapons.details:
This high tech crossbow uses racks of bolts and can fire extremely fast.
Additional Traits: Deadeye Shot may be made as a Double Action.

maneuvers.name: Rapid Fire
maneuvers.effect: Accuracy -1. Ranged. Projectile Maneuver. Reaction 1. Successive Actions.

weapons.name: Seviper’s Fang
weapons.details:
This dagger made from a carved Seviper fang still holds a trace of potent venom.
Additional Traits: Other attacks made with this Weapon gain: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Foe.

maneuvers.name: Venomous Puncture
maneuvers.effect: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target.

weapons.name: Silph Co. Synapse-X
weapons.details:
The gold standard in neural augmentation. Allows the user to do almost anything they could usually do with a top end computer or smart phone. Apparently it boosts cognitive processes too...
Traits: The implantee gains +1 to their Clever Attribute and +1 Technology Skill Point.

maneuvers.name: Augmented Intuition
maneuvers.effect: The next Maneuver the User performs has 2 automatic successes added onto their Accuracy Roll.

weapons.name: Snag Machine
weapons.details:
An illegal device that corrupts a thrown Poke Ball, allowing it to bypass the encryption usually preventing Trainer registered Pokémon from being caught. You wouldn’t use it for evil though... right?
Traits: Allows the capture of Trainer owned Pokémon.

maneuvers.name: Snag
maneuvers.effect: The next Poke Ball you throw may capture a Trainer owned Pokémon.

weapons.name: Soul Devourer
weapons.details:
This strange black bladed scimitar is inlaid with obsidian. It is said to be a Honedge, that in life was a particularly twisted and violent individual. It feasts on the souls of those slain by its edge, but might just turn on its wielder.
Additional Traits: When rolling Damage against a Foe with any attack made using this Weapon, roll a D100 Luck Check. On a 90+, if the Foe is on Pain Penalties (Or would be, ignoring spent Will). Deal Lethal Damage equal to its Max HP +1. If it is a 95+ the prior effect applies except the Foe does not need to be on Pain Penalties. If the Luck Check is a 20 or lower the attack goes off as normal, but the User takes half their remaining HP (rounded down) as Damage.

maneuvers.name: Soul Rend
maneuvers.effect: High Critical. Never Miss. Lethal.

weapons.name: Spear of Judgement
weapons.details:
This spear is made from a strange white metal. Its balanced perfectly and has gold trimming with emeralds inlaid in its filigree.
Additional Traits: When the User makes an attack with this Weapon. The Type of Damage dealt can be chosen.

maneuvers.name: Verdict of the Divine
maneuvers.effect: This Maneuver does not trigger effects that activate when the Target is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical attack. Never Miss. Roll 3 Chance Dice to change the Field-Type to Holy Ground.

weapons.name: Stim Synthesizer
weapons.details:
This curious device chemically synthesizes compounds from the local environment to boost the immune system and treat minor injuries.
Traits: The device creates 1 Healing Item of the Storyteller’s choice per day.
